user.title: Connect to EnergyTrak
user.description: Request a sign-in link from the EnergyTrak app or website, then paste the full link from that email below. The link is single-use — do not open it in a browser first.

data_description.email: The address the EnergyTrak sign-in link was sent to.
data_description.magic_link: Copy the link target from the email (right-click the sign-in button → Copy link address).

sites.title: Choose generators
sites.description: Select the EnergyTrak sites to add. If none are listed, your account cannot browse the site list — enter the site IDs manually instead.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect EnergyTrak
reauth_confirm.description: The saved credentials for {email} are no longer valid. Request a new sign-in link and paste it below.

reconfigure.title: Update EnergyTrak sign-in
reconfigure.description: Replace the stored credentials for {email}. Request a fresh sign-in link from the EnergyTrak app or website and paste it below. Do this whenever you sign in elsewhere, since a new sign-in can invalidate the token Home Assistant is using. The link is single-use — do not open it in a browser first.

data_description.email: Must be the same EnergyTrak account; to add a different account, add another integration entry.
data_description.magic_link: Copy the link target from the email (right-click the sign-in button → Copy link address).

error.invalid_magic_link: That does not look like a sign-in link — it must contain apiKey and oobCode parameters.
error.expired_link: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
error.email_mismatch: The link does not match that email address.
error.no_sites_selected: Select at least one site, or enter a site ID manually.

abort.already_configured: This EnergyTrak account is already set up.
abort.account_mismatch: That sign-in link belongs to a different EnergyTrak account. Use the original account, or add a new integration entry for the other one.

data_description.stale_minutes: Live readings (RPM, output voltage, load) are hidden when the last full equipment upload is older than this. Counters and engine hours are always shown.
